channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: OpenAI talent exodus raises 'huge red flag' ahead of IPO
item.description: OpenAI's C-suite turnover gives investors another reason for concern as the company pushes toward a mammoth IPO.

item.title: Russia's economy has defied the skeptics. Cracks are getting harder to hide
item.description: Russia's wartime economy is under growing strain as its budget deficit widens and analysts warn pressure could intensify next year.

item.title: Berkshire Hathaway boosts Alphabet to a top three holding, ups Delta and housing bets
item.description: Berkshire owned about 106 million shares in the parent of Google, worth $37.9 billion at the end of June, according to a regulatory filing released Friday.

item.title: Hawaii's Big Island under rare hurricane landfall threat as Tropical Storm Lala strengthens
item.description: A hurricane warning was issued for the Big Island, and a tropical storm warning was in effect for Maui County.

item.title: Extreme heat spurs earliest-ever Champagne harvest, putting its famous taste to the test
item.description: Producers of the iconic French fizz face a challenge to preserve its taste profile while they also battle tariff complications and fewer drinkers.

item.title: Situational Awareness filing shows AI bets before forced portfolio sale to Citadel
item.description: The hedge fund's five largest disclosed stock holdings at the end of June were Sandisk, Micron Technology, Bloom Energy, Taiwan Semiconductor and Nebius Group.

item.title: Nvidia discloses $21 billion stake in SpaceX at end of second quarter
item.description: Nvidia's stake in SpaceX, which came through an investment in xAI, was worth about $21 billion at the end of the second quarter.

item.title: Trump family-backed crypto firm World Liberty gets conditional bank charter approval
item.description: The OCC conditionally approved World Liberty Trust Co.’s national trust bank charter. That would allow the Trump family-backed firm to issue stablecoins.

item.title: Regulators and banks step up scrutiny of prediction markets
item.description: The CFTC is reviewing prediction betting platforms' so-called mention markets, people familiar with the matter confirmed to CNBC.

item.title: U.S. to use economic tactics on Iran 'that have never been seen'; Navy works to relieve troubled carrier USS Abraham Lincoln
item.description: The Trump administration is ratcheting up rhetorical pressure on Iran as the military conflict in Iran appears mired in a strategic stalemate.

item.title: New CNBC Generation Lab poll shows almost half of 18- to 34-year-olds see democratic socialism positively
item.description: New CNBC Generation Lab poll shows almost half of 18- to 34-year-olds see democratic socialism positively and nearly 80% see the U.S. economy negatively.

item.title: Mamdani's NYC pied-à-terre tax can continue rollout during court appeal
item.description: The tax championed by Mayor Zohran Mamdani has drawn the ire of President Donald Trump, who said it must be stopped and vowed to explore federal options.

item.title: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in federal case related to UnitedHealthcare CEO killing
item.description: Mangione's lawyers argue his federal plea bars his prosecution for murder in state court for Brian Thompson's slaying due to New York's double jeopardy law

item.title: The one big takeaway from a huge earnings season
item.description: The market is winding down an exceptionally strong reporting season, and there's an underlying trend that remains front and center.

item.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to let White House ballroom construction continue
item.description: President Donald Trump tore down the White House East Wing to make way for the ballroom project.

item.title: AI’s infrastructure boom is getting more leveraged — and harder to track
item.description: AI’s infrastructure boom is increasingly being funded through bonds, leases and private capital, while leveraged investors add another layer of market risk.

item.title: Disney CEO Josh D'Amaro tells CNBC parks were 'big surprise' in last quarter, company has 'clarity' and 'stability'
item.description: New CEO Josh D'Amaro has said his strategy for continued growth at Disney is centered around storytelling, intellectual property and technology.

item.title: How a niche copper trade became a real-time gauge of Trump’s next tariff move
item.description: The widening price of copper between two metals exchanges is offering investors a gauge of U.S. tariff risk.

item.title: Court rules companies can't import Gilead medications from overseas in blow to AFP health programs
item.description: A U.S. appeals court has ruled in favor of Gilead Sciences against companies known as alternative funding programs that import medicines from overseas.

item.title: Group including Jeff Bezos buys minority stake in Liverpool FC, with option to become controlling owner
item.description: The group that includes Jeff Bezos has an option to become the majority shareholder within the next year.

item.title: Goldman’s latest cash cow is all about funding the AI infrastructure boom
item.description: Nvidia and Intel recently tapped the bank to help them meeting soaring demand for compute.

item.title: 44% of Americans living paycheck to paycheck have incurred extra fees while waiting for payday. These 3 credit cards can help
item.description: Bank and credit card fees can often feel like a suckerpunch to those already struggling financially. CNBC Select highlights some ways you can avoid them.

item.title: Lamborghini unveils Revuelto SV, its most powerful production car ever
item.description: Lamborghini's Revuelto SV is a limited-edition V12 hybrid with over 1,050 horsepower, a 2.4-second 0-to-100 kph time and a $741,172 starting price.

item.title: ‘Absolutely unacceptable’: Japan PM Takaichi condemns Putin’s visit to disputed Kuril Islands
item.description: Japan protested Vladimir Putin’s first visit to the disputed Kuril Islands, escalating tensions over territory claimed by both Tokyo and Moscow.

item.title: Data breach notices have already blown past last year’s total — and AI is playing a growing role
item.description: Data breaches are surging in 2026, with artificial intelligence playing a growing role in cyberattacks, and 'malicious insider' incidents also on the rise.

item.title: Uber partners with China's Pony.ai for 2,000 robotaxis in Europe
item.description: The rollout comes as robotaxi fleet sizes become increasingly critical for commercialization.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield inches higher as traders digest soft retail sales, monitor the Middle East
item.description: The moves come after the latest retail sales figures missed expectations and the U.S. said its naval blockade of Iranian ports could continue "indefinitely."

item.title: Drone stocks rally after Trump orders tariffs on foreign-made components
item.description: The U.S. is looking to scale defense manufacturing and chip away at China's drone dominance.

item.title: Data centers in space could be a new frontier for insurers — if they can price the risk
item.description: The push to build data centers has moved to lower Earth orbit, and insurers could be facing a new market with plenty of complexity.

item.title: NATO aircraft shoot down drone over Latvia, which blames 'Russian electromagnetic warfare'
item.description: NATO fighters shot down a foreign drone over Latvia as Finland briefly restricted airspace and sea areas amid heightened Baltic security concerns.
